metadata.name: Bulwark Class Tree
metadata.description: Single continuous web layout. Trunk nodes form two central arteries. Ironclad flavor upper-left, Juggernaut upper-right, Thornwall right. Keystones at far edges. Cross-spec emerges naturally from proximity.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Taking hits, blocking and killing enemies generate Fervour. While you have this, your Fervour decays slowly out of combat.

data.name: Hardened Skin
data.description: +3% Armor per point.

data.name: Iron Constitution
data.description: +2% Maximum HP per point. At 5 points: Gain HP equal to 10% of your Armor value.

data.name: Bloody Minded
data.description: +4% HP Regen per point.

data.name: Unyielding
data.description: +1.5% damage reduction per point (multiplicative).

data.name: Warbringer
data.description: +3% damage per point.

data.name: Battle Scars
data.description: +10% Maximum Fervour per point. At 8 points: Fervour no longer decays while you are in combat.

data.name: Resolve Under Fire
data.description: +1 Fervour generated from taking hits per point. At 5 points: Taking a hit that would reduce you below 30% HP generates an additional 10 Fervour.

data.name: Tempered Steel
data.description: +2% Armor and +1% damage for every 25 Fervour currently held per point. At 6 points: These bonuses are doubled while at maximum Fervour.

data.name: Unbroken
data.description: You cannot be stunned while above 50 Fervour.

data.name: Blood and Sweat
data.description: Killing an enemy generates 1 Fervour, up to 5 per second.

data.name: Last Resort
data.description: When you drop below 20% HP, instantly gain 50 Fervour. Can only trigger once every 60 seconds.

data.name: Steeled Resolve
data.description: While above 50 Fervour, gain +3% damage reduction per point. This bonus drains 5 Fervour per second while active. At 6 points: Reduces the drain rate to 2 Fervour per second.

data.name: Shield Mastery
data.description: +2% Block Chance per point. At 5 points: Blocking an attack generates 3 Fervour.

data.name: Iron Wall
data.description: +4% damage reduction on a successful block per point (multiplicative).

data.name: Iron Will
data.description: While above 75 Fervour, blocked attacks automatically negate all damage from that hit, draining 20 Fervour per block. Per point: reduces the Fervour drain by 2.

data.name: Stalwart
data.description: +2% Armor per point while a shield is equipped.

data.name: Reinforced Guard
data.description: +3% Maximum HP per point while a shield is equipped.

data.name: Counter Stance
data.description: +4% damage per point for 3 seconds after taking a hit. At 6 points: If you take two hits within 1 second, this bonus is doubled.

data.name: Consecutive Blocks
data.description: +2% damage reduction per successive block per point, stacking up to 5 times. Resets if you take an unblocked hit.

data.name: Punishing Blow
data.description: +3% damage per point for 3 seconds after a successful block.

data.name: Shield Slam
data.description: +2% damage per point for every 10% Block Chance you have. At 6 points: Whenever you take a hit while your block streak is active, your next attack deals bonus flat damage equal to 5% of your Armor value.

data.name: Aegis Strike
data.description: +3% damage per point for every 10% Block Chance you have.

data.name: Unbreakable Will
data.description: +2% of blocked damage is added to your next attack per point. At 5 points: This bonus is tripled if you block 5 times without attacking.

data.name: Resolve to Steel
data.description: +1% Block Chance per 10 Fervour currently held per point.

data.name: Fortified Mind
data.description: +3% Fervour generation from blocking per point. At 5 points: While at maximum Fervour, blocking deals 200 flat damage back to the attacker.

data.name: Living Fortress
data.description: +2% damage reduction per point for each enemy within 3 meters (multiplicative). At 6 points: Also grants +1% Block Chance per nearby enemy.

data.name: Indomitable
data.description: +2% of your total Block Chance is added as flat damage reduction per point (multiplicative).

data.name: Riposte
data.description: After a successful block, if you have at least 25 Fervour, automatically unleash a counter-attack dealing damage equal to 75% of the damage just blocked, draining 25 Fervour. While at maximum Fervour this counter-attack also stuns the target for 1 second.

data.name: Unyielding Guard
data.description: Every block within 3 seconds of the last increases Block Chance by 5% and generates 3 Fervour, stacking up to 4 times. Resets if you stop blocking for 3 seconds.

data.name: Eye of the Storm
data.description: While 3 or more enemies are within 3 meters, you gain 10 Fervour per second and your Block Chance cannot be reduced below 30%.

data.name: The Last Bastion
data.description: When you block an attack that would have killed you, instead survive at 1 HP, gain 100 Fervour, and become immune to damage for 2 seconds. Can only trigger once every 120 seconds.

data.name: Meat Shield
data.description: +4% Maximum HP per point. Each 1,000 Maximum HP above 5,000 increases your Fervour cap by 5.

data.name: Ironblood
data.description: +50 flat HP Regen per second per point.

data.name: Blood Tithe
data.description: Lose 5 Fervour for every 100 flat HP regenerated. While above 50% Fervour, gain 50% Maximum HP. At 6 points: The Fervour cost is reduced to 1 per 150 HP regenerated.

data.name: Immovable
data.description: +2% damage reduction per point while you have not moved in the last 2 seconds. At 5 points: While stationary, your Fervour generation from taking hits is doubled.

data.name: Crushing Presence
data.description: +100 flat damage per point. Requires 5,000 Maximum HP to activate.

data.name: Iron Mind
data.description: +15% crowd control duration reduction per point. Each crowd control effect applied to you generates 10 Fervour.

data.name: Colossus
data.description: +200 flat HP per point for every 10,000 Maximum HP you have. Requires 10,000 Maximum HP to activate.

data.name: Dead Weight
data.description: +3% damage reduction per point while crowd controlled (multiplicative). At 4 points: Taking a crowd control effect retaliates with 500 flat damage.

data.name: Dense Muscle
data.description: +2% damage reduction per point for every 5,000 Maximum HP above 10,000 (multiplicative).

data.name: Unstoppable Force
data.description: +1% damage per point for every 1,000 Maximum HP above 10,000.

data.name: Weight of the World
data.description: +50 flat damage per point for every 5,000 Maximum HP you have. Requires 8,000 Maximum HP to activate.

data.name: War of Attrition
data.description: +2% damage per point for every 5 seconds in continuous combat, stacking up to 10 times.

data.name: Seismic Slam
data.description: +4% chance per point for melee attacks to deal bonus flat damage equal to 1% of your Maximum HP. At 5 points: This bonus damage hits all enemies within 2 meters.

data.name: Grinding Advance
data.description: +1% damage reduction per point for every 10 seconds in continuous combat (multiplicative), stacking up to 5 times. At 5 points: Combat duration stacks are lost 50% slower when leaving combat.

data.name: Walking Fortress
data.description: +500 flat Maximum HP per point. At 6 points: For every 10,000 Maximum HP you have, gain 1% of your Maximum HP as flat damage reduction (multiplicative).

data.name: Immovable Object
data.description: While above 15,000 Maximum HP, you are immune to all crowd control effects. Enemies that attempt to crowd control you instead take 500 flat damage.

data.name: Mountain's Wrath
data.description: Once every 10 seconds, your next attack deals bonus damage equal to 5% of your Maximum HP as flat damage. Requires 20,000 Maximum HP to activate.

data.name: The Inevitable
data.description: After 10 seconds in continuous combat, you emit an aura that deals flat damage per second to all nearby enemies equal to 1% of your Maximum HP. This damage increases by 0.5% of your Maximum HP for every additional 10 seconds in combat, up to a maximum of 3% of your Maximum HP per second.

data.name: Titanfall
data.description: When you absorb a single hit exceeding 5,000 flat damage, you become unkillable for 2 seconds and your next attack deals damage equal to the full amount of that hit. Requires 25,000 Maximum HP to activate. Can only trigger once every 30 seconds.

data.name: Barbed Skin
data.description: +2% damage reflected to attackers per point (multiplicative).

data.name: Thick Hide
data.description: +3% damage reduction per point (multiplicative). At 6 points: Each hit you survive increases your retaliation damage by 1% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

data.name: Absorb and Return
data.description: +3% bonus retaliation damage per point for hits that deal more than 10% of your max HP in a single strike.

data.name: Spiteful
data.description: +3% Fervour generated from taking hits per point. At 5 points: When you reach maximum Fervour from taking hits, your next retaliation deals 50% bonus damage.

data.name: Vengeful Discharge
data.description: Passively drains 10 Fervour per second to increase your retaliation damage by +3% per point. When this drain reduces you to 0 Fervour, automatically trigger a retaliation pulse hitting all nearby enemies for 100% of your retaliation damage. At 5 points: This pulse also applies a bleed stack to all enemies hit.

data.name: Martyrdom
data.description: +5% retaliation damage per point for 5 seconds after taking a hit that reduces you below 50% HP.

data.name: Wrath Incarnate
data.description: +2% retaliation damage per point for each unique enemy that has hit you in the last 10 seconds. While at maximum Fervour, your retaliation damage hits all nearby enemies rather than just your attacker.

data.name: Pain is Power
data.description: +2% damage per point for every 10% of missing HP. At 5 points: This bonus also applies to retaliation damage.

data.name: Serrated Edge
data.description: +10% bleed duration per point applied by your retaliation damage.

data.name: Aura of Pain
data.description: +5% aura retaliation damage per point. Enemies within 3 meters take retaliation damage equal to a percentage of damage dealt to you.

data.name: Blood Price
data.description: +5% bleed damage per point for each bleed stack on the target.

data.name: Spreading Thorns
data.description: +1 meter to retaliation aura radius per point. At 4 points: Enemies killed within the aura explode, dealing retaliation damage to nearby enemies.

data.name: Endless Spite
data.description: +1% retaliation damage per point for every 10 Fervour currently held.

data.name: Open Wounds
data.description: +3% retaliation damage per point for each bleed stack on any nearby enemy. At 5 points: Enemies with 5 or more bleed stacks take 20% increased damage from all sources.

data.name: Undying Rage
data.description: +3% retaliation damage per point for every 10% HP missing. At 6 points: While below 25% HP, retaliation damage is doubled and cannot be reduced by enemy resistances.

data.name: Flesh Fortress
data.description: Convert all of your Armor into flat HP. For every 1% Armor lost this way, gain 3% Maximum HP. You can no longer equip shields. Gain 50% increased Fervour from all sources.

data.name: Hemorrhage
data.description: Your retaliation damage no longer deals instant damage. Instead it is converted into a bleed whose total damage equals the amount that would have been reflected.

data.name: Wrathful Presence
data.description: Your retaliation aura now pulses every second, dealing damage equal to 5% of all damage you have taken in the last 5 seconds to all nearby enemies.

data.name: Blood for Blood
data.description: 50% of all damage you take is reflected back to the attacker. This reflection ignores resistances and cannot be blocked or evaded. The reflection percentage increases by 1% for every 5 Fervour currently held, up to a maximum of 100% at full Fervour.

data.name: First Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Flesh Oath
options.description: Regenerate 1% of your current HP per second.

options.name: Blood Oath
options.description: Your retaliation damage ignores 25% of enemy resistances.

data.name: Second Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Iron Aegis
options.description: Your Block Chance is doubled while you have not attacked in the last 3 seconds.

options.name: Thornwall
options.description: Enemies that hit you are inflicted with a stack of Exposed. Each stack of Exposed increases the retaliation damage they take from you by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

data.name: Third Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Bastion
options.description: Your Maximum HP is increased by 1% for every 1% Block Chance you have.

options.name: Bloodied but Unbroken
options.description: Your retaliation damage is increased by 1% for every 75 HP you are missing.

options.name: Spiteful Guard
options.description: Blocked damage is stored and added to your next retaliation hit.

data.name: Final Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: The Unbreakable Wall
options.description: You may equip a shield in your primary weapon slot. You may now block AOE damage.

options.name: Colossus Eternal
options.description: All healing, regeneration, and HP bonuses are doubled. While above 50% HP, you are immune to instant-kill effects. While above 75% HP, your attacks deal bonus damage equal to 2% of your current HP.

options.name: Wrath Incarnate
options.description: Your retaliation damage percentage is added to your total Armor, and your Armor contributes to your retaliation damage proportional to the damage reduction it provides. When you take a hit that would deal more than 10% of your Maximum HP in a single strike, you erupt — instantly retaliating against all nearby enemies for 200% of your retaliation damage.
